text: maya: Quick flag: compact scorecard keyboard behavior is confusing in the wild. Users expect Enter to open a diff but right now Enter approves. GIF: https://gif.redwood.ai/compact-hotkey.gif lee: oh yikes. that violates common table patterns. I think Enter=open, Space=toggle selection, and a separate combo for approve is safer. harper: agree. on mac we need Cmd mapping too (Cmd+Enter). Also think Shift+A or Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+A for bulk approve so it doesn't conflict. olivia: accessibility thoughts: modals that confirm approvals currently trap focus and feel jarring. prefer inline snackbar undo instead of modal unless the user opts in for confirmation. also we need visible focus outlines in compact rows (currently too subtle). maya: proposal: Enter opens diff panel & focuses inside. Space toggles selection. Use Shift+A to approve (keyboard hint shows Shift+A). Show a tiny hint chip on row focus: "Enter ▸ Space ␣ Shift+A ✔" lee: chip on focus sounds good. but design space is tiny. use styling and abbreviations. render only on focus/hover to avoid clutter. harper: a11y nit: tooltips/chips must be accessible. add a hidden description element per row and point aria-describedby at it so screen readers get the shortcut list. avoid announcing it repeatedly. olivia: microcopy: prefer "Approve selected tests" (explicit) over "Bulk approve". snackbar should read "Approved 3 tests — Undo" (verb first). maya: also when opening a regression diff, we should announce via aria-live: "Opened diff for [prompt set name]. 3 changes." but only when the panel is opened, not on each arrow/tab navigation. lee: debounce aria-live updates (300ms) and only trigger on open action, not focus. prevents spammy output if keyboard-navigation is fast. harper: example hidden markup to attach to row focus: ``` Enter: open diff. Space: toggle selection. Shift+A: approve selected tests. ... ``` This keeps the visible chip and an accessible hook in sync. olivia: add unit tests for screenreader text (axe/voiceover smoke) and include localization tokens for the snackbar so translators can reorder the verb. maya: action items: maya -> update Figma and push compact layout with hint chip; lee -> prototype chip behavior (show on focus, hide on blur); harper -> small a11y PR with aria-describedby and live region debounce; olivia -> update copy tokens and snackbar work. ux-bot: created task PROD-3250 "Scorecard compact: keyboard shortcuts + a11y" (https://tasks.redwood.ai/3250) assigned to maya, lee, harper. lee: tiny copy tweak suggestion: in chip use symbols not words: "Enter ▸ Space ␣ Shift+A ✓" so it reads quickly at small sizes. maya: noted. I'll post the Figma link when ready. thanks! :sparkles:
